speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for seeing me. You mentioned a longstanding pruritic rash with numbness and tingling in your palms; how long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and does the rash appear only when you wash your hands or after contact with water?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Leishmaniasis (likely post-kala-azar dermal leishmaniasis or diffuse cutaneous leishmaniasis) due to exposure to livestock and the specific combination of a chronic pruritic rash with peripheral neuropathy (numbness/tingling) in an endemic agricultural setting. The sensory changes suggest significant immune dysregulation or direct neural involvement common in visceral or diffuse forms of the disease.

REQUEST IMAGES: Full_body_skin_examination, especially face and upper torso.
REQUEST TEST: Leishmanin_skin_test, Complete_blood_count_with_differential, Liver_function_tests.
